What new sandboxes inherit: variables (plain and protected), secret files, repositories and egress grants; and a sandbox's egress log.

## List environments

`GET /v1/environments` (SDK method `listEnvironments`)

The account's environments, oldest first. A key needs `account:read`.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | string | no | The account to act in: the caller's personal account (the default for a person) or an organisation they belong to. An API key always acts in its own account, and naming another is `forbidden`. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [EnvironmentList](/api/reference/types/#environmentlist) (`application/json`). The environments.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Create an environment

`POST /v1/environments` (SDK method `createEnvironment`)

An empty environment, named uniquely in the account. A sandbox starts with it when its create names it. A key needs `account:admin`.

**Body**: [CreateEnvironmentBody](/api/reference/types/#createenvironmentbody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [Environment](/api/reference/types/#environment) (`application/json`). The environment.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get an environment

`GET /v1/environments/{environmentId}` (SDK method `getEnvironment`)

Never a protected variable's value nor a secret file's contents. A key needs `account:read`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes | The environment's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Environment](/api/reference/types/#environment) (`application/json`). The environment.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Change an environment

`PATCH /v1/environments/{environmentId}` (SDK method `updateEnvironment`)

Renames it or changes its description. A key needs `account:admin`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes | The environment's ID. |

**Body**: [UpdateEnvironmentBody](/api/reference/types/#updateenvironmentbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Environment](/api/reference/types/#environment) (`application/json`). The environment.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Delete an environment

`DELETE /v1/environments/{environmentId}` (SDK method `deleteEnvironment`)

Sandboxes made from it keep what they started with, but their protected variables stop resolving at once. A key needs `account:admin`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes | The environment's ID. |

**Answers**

- `204`: no body. Deleted.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Set an environment variable

`PUT /v1/environments/{environmentId}/variables/{name}` (SDK method `setEnvironmentVariable`)

Adds or changes a variable. A protected one needs at least one binding, and its value is kept encrypted and never shown again; leave `value` out to change only its bindings. A new value for a protected variable is a rotation: sandboxes keep their placeholders, and their next request carries the new value. Running sandboxes made from it pick the change up at once. Kantel's own names (`KANTEL_*`, `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, `NO_PROXY`, in any case) are refused. Protected values need the deployment's secrets key (`not_supported` without one). A key needs `account:admin`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes | The environment's ID. |
| `name` | string | yes | The variable's name. |

**Body**: [SetEnvironmentVariableBody](/api/reference/types/#setenvironmentvariablebody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Environment](/api/reference/types/#environment) (`application/json`). The environment.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Delete an environment variable

`DELETE /v1/environments/{environmentId}/variables/{name}` (SDK method `deleteEnvironmentVariable`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `environmentId` | string | yes | The environment's ID. |
| `name` | string | yes | The variable's name. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Environment](/api/reference/types/#environment) (`application/json`). The environment.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Set a secret file

`PUT /v1/environments/{environmentId}/files` (SDK method `setEnvironmentFile`)

Adds or replaces a file new sandboxes start with, written once they are running. Its contents are kept encrypted and never shown again; leave `content` out to change only its mode. Needs the deployment's secrets key (`not_supported` without one). A key needs `account:admin`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes | The environment's ID. |

**Body**: [SetEnvironmentFileBody](/api/reference/types/#setenvironmentfilebody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Environment](/api/reference/types/#environment) (`application/json`). The environment.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Delete a secret file

`DELETE /v1/environments/{environmentId}/files` (SDK method `deleteEnvironmentFile`)

Sandboxes made from the environment keep their copy. A key needs `account:admin`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes | The environment's ID. |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  (at most 1024 characters) |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Environment](/api/reference/types/#environment) (`application/json`). The environment.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Set an environment's repositories

`PUT /v1/environments/{environmentId}/repos` (SDK method `putEnvironmentRepos`)

Replaces them. New sandboxes clone each once they are running (`git clone --depth 1`), through the egress proxy. A key needs `account:admin`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes | The environment's ID. |

**Body**: [PutEnvironmentReposBody](/api/reference/types/#putenvironmentreposbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Environment](/api/reference/types/#environment) (`application/json`). The environment.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get a sandbox's egress

`GET /v1/sandboxes/{sandboxId}/egress` (SDK method `getSandboxEgress`)

Its environment, its protected variables (each placeholder's first 8 characters, never a value), its grants and the newest of its egress log: what its host's proxy let through or refused. A key needs `account:read`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sandboxId` | string | yes | The sandbox's ID. |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | no | At most this many entries; default 100. (minimum 1, maximum 1000) |

**Answers**

- `200`: [SandboxEgress](/api/reference/types/#sandboxegress) (`application/json`). Its egress.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Set a sandbox's egress grants

`PUT /v1/sandboxes/{sandboxId}/grants` (SDK method `putSandboxGrants`)

Replaces its own grants, on top of its environment's. A running sandbox picks them up at once. A key needs `account:admin`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sandboxId` | string | yes | The sandbox's ID. |

**Body**: [PutEgressGrantsBody](/api/reference/types/#putegressgrantsbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [SandboxEgress](/api/reference/types/#sandboxegress) (`application/json`). Its egress.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
